_comment: Tier-2 for febio::rigid_body#2. The shipped indentation template run with and without its <Contact> section: with it, the block surface under the punch follows and only a small fraction of the contact travel remains as interpenetration; without it, the surface does not move and the ENTIRE travel becomes interpenetration. Both reach normal termination with exit 0, the same completed-step count, and no ERROR or WARNING — the missing interface is never mentioned. The fixture filters block-top nodes to the punch FOOTPRINT; an earlier draft took the extreme over all top nodes, which measures the untouched rim and reported working contact as inactive. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
